messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-router` (policy: latency-p95). Alert details: p95 latency 1.35s over 2m threshold. PD: INC987654321.

alex: acked

alex: looking at grafana now, grabbing a quick snapshot.

sam: thx. is this global or just a region?

alex: looks like eu-west spike only, RB/ingress p95 up to ~1.3s for ~90s then trending down.

maria: synthetic-canary shows a ~1.2s blip around the same time, resolved within 2m. no 5xx seen in logs.

alex: curl healthcheck to a few router pods returns 200s. `kubectl top` doesn't show unusual CPU.

alex: logs show a flurry of short lived `open-conn` warnings right before the spike, likely ephemeral jitter from a cloud load-balancer reconnection.

linda: PD has been noisy for the same signal earlier today, might be duplicate pages from the same transient. can we suppress repeats?

sam: agree, customer-facing errors = none. Impact = limited to elevated latency for a small percent of requests in eu-west. recommend short suppression and monitor.

alex: I'll set a temporary incident annotation and request PD to suppress duplicate triggers for 15m. adding note: "suspected LB reconnection, no client errors observed"

PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by alex (on-call). Suppression rule applied: duplicate incidents muted for 15 minutes. INC987654321 status: acknowledged.

maria: for visibility — rolling autoscale event happened ~30s earlier per K8s events, might have created additional connection churn.

alex: copying relevant snippet:
```
kubectl get events --namespace=router | tail -n 5
2026-03-10T15:04:12Z    Normal  ScalingReplicaSet  Scaled up replica set router-abcdef to 3
2026-03-10T15:04:45Z    Normal  SuccessfulCreate   Created pod router-abcdef-xyz
2026-03-10T15:05:05Z    Warning  Unhealthy       LBs reported transient conn resets
```

sam: ok makes sense. recommend we keep an eye for 10m and if it resolves, close. if it repeats -> escalate to infra.

linda: tagged infra oncall (cc @infra) and also added a quick query to the dashboard to alert only on sustained >3m window to reduce noise.

Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident INC987654321 resolved automatically (no further activity). Resolution reason: duplicate suppression + signal dropped below threshold.

alex: thanks — no customer-facing errors, short eu-west latency blip correlated with autoscale/LB churn. no further action.

maria: noting that our canary thresholds may need a small debounce on region-specific spikes. filing a follow-up ticket.

sam: handing off to night oncall: linda, FYI — if you see repeat in the next hour escalate to infra.

linda: got it, watching. :eyes:

alex: closing thread, filing a tiny postmortem note (non-incident) with graphs and the K8s event snippets.

maria: :thumbsup:
